pairs.question: Tu autem cum ipse tantum librorum habeas, quos hic tandem requiris?
pairs.answer: Commentarios quosdam, Aristotelios, quos hic sciebam esse, veni ut auferrem, quos legerem, dum essem otiosus.
pairs.derivation: Cato asks (interrogative quos...requiris?) what books Cicero is looking for. The section marker [10] and the framing 'Tum ille:' are scaffolding/narration and dropped. In the reply the speech tag 'inquam' is dropped from 'Commentarios quosdam, inquam, Aristotelios'. Answer ends at the first full stop; the following 'quod quidem nobis non saepe contingit' is an added aside on being at leisure, cut as elaboration.

pairs.question: Quaero nonne tibi faciendum idem sit nihil dicenti bonum, quod non rectum honestumque sit, reliquarum rerum discrimen omne tollenti?
pairs.derivation: Genuine interrogative (nonne) in which Cicero asks whether Cato must abolish all distinction among other things. The section marker [13], the lead 'Istud quidem, inquam, optime dicis, sed' (praise that precedes the question), and the speech tag 'inquam' are dropped as framing; 'quaero' is kept as it introduces the actual question. Cato answers directly: 'Si quidem, inquit, tollerem, sed relinquo' with the tag 'inquit' dropped. Self-contained answer; nothing cut after it.
